cases.source:
claim:
    ? forall f fn(x cart_n(R,2)) R,p cart_n(R,2),A,B R:
        $Calc::higher_order::has_ordered_partial_at(2,cart_n(R,2),2,f,p,scalar::regularity_forward,A)
        $Calc::higher_order::has_ordered_partial_at(2,cart_n(R,2),2,f,p,scalar::regularity_reverse,B)
        =>:
            A=B
    release thm Reg::main::ordered_second_partials_swap_c_two(2,cart_n(R,2),f,p,scalar::regularity_forward,scalar::regularity_reverse,A,B)

claim:
    ? forall f fn(x cart_n(R,2)) R,p cart_n(R,2),A,B R:
        $Calc::higher_order::has_ordered_partial_at(2,cart_n(R,2),2,f,p,scalar::regularity_forward,A)
        $Calc::higher_order::has_ordered_partial_at(2,cart_n(R,2),2,f,p,scalar::regularity_reverse,B)
        $Reg::main::is_scalar_c_k_on_open(2,cart_n(R,2),0,f)
        =>:
            A=B
    release thm Reg::main::ordered_second_partials_swap_c_two(2,cart_n(R,2),f,p,scalar::regularity_forward,scalar::regularity_reverse,A,B)
